name: statusline
description: A Claude Code status line with no config file: model, effort, context, git branch, and weekly / 5-hour usage that only appears once it gets high

enabled.title: Status line
enabled.description: Keep this status line set in your settings.json. Off removes it (only if it is this one)

usageFrom.title: Show usage from (%)
usageFrom.description: Weekly and 5-hour usage stay hidden below this percent, then show in yellow. 0 = always show

orangeFrom.title: Orange from (%)
orangeFrom.description: Usage turns orange from this percent

redFrom.title: Red from (%)
redFrom.description: Usage turns bold red from this percent

showEffort.title: Show effort
showEffort.description: Effort level next to the model name

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Percent of the context window used

showResets.title: Show reset timers
showResets.description: Time until each usage window resets, next to its percent
